nodes.label: Universidad del Cauca Logo
nodes.description: Institutional logo of Universidad del Cauca. Contains the university's heraldic shield/coat of arms on the left (featuring ornate decorative border and central emblem) and the text 'Universidad del Cauca' in two lines on the right. Light gray/white color scheme, used as a branding asset in the DeporteParaTodos frontend application (likely in login or header area to identify the institution).
